calls.video_title: Get Paid Every Month Without Selling a Share
calls.thesis: WisdomTree US High Dividend Fund: 300+ steady dividend payers (ABBV, XOM, PM); no MSFT/AAPL near the top.
calls.base_case: Monthly checks from established companies, beat the S&P 500 over 5 years.
calls.bull_case: Five-year total return beat the S&P 500.
calls.bear_case: Fell ~37% in the 2020 COVID crash, slightly more than the S&P 500.
